title: Orion Properties Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
summary: PHOENIX, November 05, 2026--Orion Properties Inc. (NYSE: ONL) ("Orion" or the "Company"), a fully-integrated real estate investment trust ("REIT") which owns a diversified portfolio of single-tenant net lease office properties including dedicated use assets located across the United States, announced today its operating results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.

title: Net Lease Office Properties Declares Special Cash Distribution of $1.50 Per Share
summary: Net Lease Office Properties (NYSE: NLOP) reported today that its Board of Trustees declared a special cash distribution of $1.50 per common share, totaling approximately $22 million. The distribution is payable on December 1, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 16, 2026. Including this distribution, NLOP has declared distributions totaling $24.19 per share since being spun off in November 2023.
